newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk files proxy papers vs Conrail plan.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk files proxy papers vs Conrail plan.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Tuesday it had filed a definitive proxy statement with regulators seeking to block Conrail Inc's plan to amend its company articles.
Under the plan, Conrail would seek shareholder approval to "opt out" of the Pennsylvania Control Transaction Law.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Norfolk said it had received on Monday signed commitments from banks for over $15 billion to fund its proposed $100 a share cash offer for Conrail.
Norfolk is seeking to stop Conrail from concluding a proposed $8.4 billion merger with CSX Corp or $92.50 a share in cash and stock.
